title: Quantization robustness & latency sweep with adaptive load guard
creator: Aditi Rao
description: End-to-end benchmarking ticket to measure performance/quality trade-offs across FP16, INT8, and INT4 quantization profiles using a new adaptive load harness. Goal: produce a matrix of tokens/sec, p95 latency, and quality deltas under steady-state and burst traffic and wire up regression detection alerts and automated fallback in Console.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Clear throughput and p95 curves for FP16/INT8/INT4 across 3 load shapes (steady 200rps, burst 2k/10s, staircase up to saturation). 2) Quality regressions defined (delta-embed-sim < -0.01 OR ROUGE-L drop > 1.5) and automated sentinel alerts firing in test env. 3) Canary rollout + automatic fallback to highest-compatible profile under detected quality regression. 4) Dashboard and PR with artifacts + reproducible harness runbook.
approach: Build an adaptive-load harness that exercises model variants with synchronized quality evals. Harness will run 3 axes: model_precision (FP16, INT8, INT4), request_shape (chat short, longform summary), and load_shape (steady, burst, staircase). Capture tokens/sec, p95/p99 latencies, KV cache hit rates, and per-request quality scores (embedding cosine vs FP16 baseline, ROUGE-L where applicable, hallucination flag heuristics). Implement regression rules (embed-sim, ROUGE, hallucination-rate) and wire into the Console test dashboard for visual regression and PagerDuty test alerting.
test_plan: Datasets: 1) GovSumm-Long (2000+ token summaries) 2) Chat-Edge prompt bank (mix of multi-turn up to 6 turns). Metrics: tokens_per_second (aggregate), p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, prefix_kv_cache_hit_pct, median_embed_cosine, ROUGE-L, hallucination_delta. Load shapes: steady 200rps for 15m, burst 2k for 10s repeated 5x, staircase ramp 0->2k over 12m. Environment: dedicated test cluster runtime-1.22 (same kernel selection as prod). Baseline: FP16 single-node profile pinned to model-v1. Run permutations with 5 seeds and aggregate medians.
results_summary: Preliminary results from 2026-03-11 harness run against model-v1 on G5-class nodes: FP16 baseline tokens/sec=1000 (steady), p95=92ms. INT8 median tokens/sec=1620 (+62%), p95=70ms (-24%). INT4 median tokens/sec=2240 (+124%), p95=48ms (-48%). Quality deltas vs FP16 baseline (median_embed_cosine): INT8=0.996 (0.4% drop), INT4=0.985 (1.5% drop). ROUGE-L on GovSumm: FP16=41.8, INT8=41.2 (-0.6), INT4=39.9 (-1.9). Hallucination heuristic (entity-repeat & contradiction markers): INT8 delta +0.4%, INT4 delta +1.8%. Under burst profiles, INT4 shows rare long-tail p99 spikes correlated with specific long-history prompts; added a workaround to use hybrid KV fallback for sequences >1024 tokens.
regression_detection: Rules implemented in harness: 1) embed-sim-drop rule: trigger if median_embed_cosine drops by >= 0.01 vs pinned FP16 baseline. 2) rouge-drop rule: trigger if ROUGE-L drops by >= 1.5 absolute. 3) hallucination rule: trigger if hallucination_rate increases by >= 1.0% absolute. Alerts post to test PagerDuty channel and create a Console incident card. Regression detection runs after each 15m steady window and after each burst cycle. Tuned to minimize false positives via bootstrap on 5 seeds.
